text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While strolling through town on my day off,
I ran into Orfèvre.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
This is a royal decree.
Find Stay Gold.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Word has reached me
that she has appeared in this town.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice.
I bestow upon you the honor of serving as my pawn.
choice_data_list: Umm, calling me a pawn all of a sudden is...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre's Subject A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Orfèvre! Reports say someone matching
her description was sighted in the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
You heard that, didn't you?
Then make haste and go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, I was roped in without any say.
The target is the carefree wanderer—Stay Gold.
Will we actually be able to track her down...?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
You.
Where are you?
choice_data_list: "Huh? I'm heading towards the shopping district..."

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Word from my subjects.
She has appeared at the park.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
No questions.
Head to the park.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I head to the park as told... but nobody is there.
Immediately after, my phone rings once more.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
"What are you doing?
She has already moved to the mountains."

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
"—Too slow.
Head for the port next."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst a flurry of conflicting information,
I run all over the place with phone in hand.
Yet it's one wild goose chase after another until sunset...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
"—Search.
She is right there."
choice_data_list: (Uhh, even if you tell me that...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around, there's not a single trace
of anyone matching her description.
...Just as I am about to suggest calling it a day—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
"That melody—so you've caught her.
I shall make an appearance myself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hanging up the phone, I notice the sound of a harmonica
drifting along with the murmuring of the tide.
Following the melody as I walk...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Well now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—I see.
So Orfe's been running you ragged, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Whoops. Speak of the devil...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
The King has arrived in person.
Prostrate yourself and show your gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Orfe.
Looks like you had a hard time finding me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
How was it?
Did you enjoy the game of tag?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: As far as amusements go, it was passable.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Still, impressive that you tracked me down here.
Even though I didn't tell a soul.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... With the King's majestic authority,
no matter where you hide, I will uncover you.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Do not dream of escaping.
My reach encompasses all of creation.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I yield, I yield!
As expected of the "Gilded Tyrant."

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
...Offer up that praise
without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfèvre carries her usual arrogant demeanor.
Yet, behind every word,
she sounds somewhat amused.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ...What are you staring at?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So as not to give anything away,
I avert my eyes from Orfèvre.
Instead looking around at our surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, Stay Gold had vanished,
as though dissolving into the sea breeze.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Gone already?
—Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Wherever she may wander,
I shall inevitably capture her once more.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Even a free-spirited wanderer
remains in the palm of the King's hand.
choice_data_list: Do you really think you can find her again?
I'll help you out again next time!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —A foolish question.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
The King's majesty illuminates everything.
Even to the furthest ends of the three thousand realms.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
When that time comes, you shall serve your purpose as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
I anticipate an even greater performance
than what you showed today.
